scope: Actual 3B UI and real form validator in an isolated fixture copy. Synthetic reads and deliberately mocked save conflicts only. No hosted Supabase Auth, persistence, RLS, PostgREST or Storage enforcement claimed.
checks: Desktop saved layout fits viewport
Summary separates 150 m² floor, 20 m² glass, 300 m² reference, one pending zone and one N/A
Saved zone shows measurement sources, notes, material, restrictions and distinct units
Desktop layout editor fits viewport
Edit initializes exact saved zero, unknown and N/A measurements
All layout controls have associated labels and distinct DOM identities
Duplicate creates new identity, focuses name, and clears all quantities, sources and observations
Layout-only edits trigger unsaved-change warning and cancellation retains data
Zone removal requires confirmation; cancel preserves draft and confirm removes it
Add floor and zone preserves parent identity; confirmed floor removal removes draft children
Changing populated measurement status can be cancelled without losing source or quantity
Real server validation requires unknown reason, focuses errors and preserves measurements
Measurement error link opens nested zone and moves keyboard focus to its measurement group
Simulated conflict freezes floor/zone editing and preserves draft with canonical saved-visit link
Mobile new layout fits viewport
New visit reuses building identities and resets every observation and reference measurement
Mobile open measurement fields fits viewport
Mobile save controls remain in normal document flow and measured zero is retained
Offline indicator prevents saves and retains layout entries until reconnect
First-save inventory conflict explains unsaved status and recovers to a fresh visit instead of nonexistent saved record
Tablet stale inventory fits viewport
Explicit inventory reconciliation confirms removals, refreshes structure and retains surviving measurements
Read-only historical revision retains 125 m² and original floor names independently of current 150 m²
Legacy revision without layout displays unrecorded state rather than empty/zero building
Browser Back after layout-only change warns and cancellation keeps new-visit draft
